integrity: Self-contained proof and an independent face-enumeration checker; no assertion of independent external validation.
scientific_limitations: Exactly two vertex-disjoint reversed arcs of a finite simple bipartite graph; full homotopy equivalence by cofiber, with an augmented empty matching convention; no adjacent or more than two reversed-arc classification. Finite checker is not an infinite/integral proof. Three-torsion corollary uses Jonsson 2012.
title: Two reversed arcs transfer matching-complex topology through a directed four-cycle
